title: Chainsmoker Cat
titleNative: ヤニねこ
synopsis: Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! synopsis: Sharks don't have lungs, but they do have to breathe oxygen to survive. Instead of breathing air, though, sharks get oxygen from the water that surrounds them. synonyms: Dye Blue, Even If You Die
synopsis: The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? synopsis: In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

synopsis: Ryou is in his last year of high school, and he's enjoying his otaku life to the fullest — except for a certain girl who's really getting on his nerves. She goes to his school and she's none other than his cocky two-year younger childhood-friend, Asahi-chan! Though she's suppose to be his kouhai, she's always teasing him whenever she gets the chance! On the other hand, if she gets teased back, she starts acting like "you can't say anything mean to me because I'm a cute girl." Furthermore, she's "afraid of people with practically no friends who can't be honest with their feelings." Someday, somehow, someone has to set this cocky Asahi-chan straight! title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)
